description: 2.0s OOD window sensitivity and window feature-importance sweeps do not filter out the 8 non-causal OOD scenarios (t_nadir <= t0 + 2.0s) and do not distinguish window-specific causal subsets from common causal intersection
scientific_impact: Includes 8 post-nadir/at-nadir OOD trajectories in T_obs=2.0s metrics (min lead time -0.22s), violating strict pre-nadir causality (t0 + T_obs < t_nadir)
proposed_fix: Enforce strict pre-nadir causal masking jointly across X, y_nadir, y_secure, metadata, and lead_time in WindowSensitivityBenchmark and InterpretabilityAnalyzer; report excluded counts/IDs and both window-specific causal and common-intersection populations
verification_method: Unit/regression test with non-causal 2.0s scenarios verifying exclusion from metrics and exact n_excluded=8 on 750-scenario OOD sweep

description: Statistical comparison uses uncentered bootstrap tail-sign p-value, combines Wilcoxon and bootstrap via an unjustified OR rule, and lacks Holm multiple-comparison correction
scientific_impact: Marks Brier comparisons where 95% CI crosses zero (e.g. Platt vs Logistic +0.0009 [-0.0131, +0.0206], Platt vs DT -0.0051 [-0.0298, +0.0100]) as statistically significant due to tie/rounding rank artifacts and unadjusted OR testing
proposed_fix: Implement null-centered paired sign-flip permutation p-value for mean loss difference alongside paired bootstrap 95% CI, report Wilcoxon signed-rank separately with explanation, apply Holm step-down correction across comparison families, and compare both validation-selected Ridge and proposed GBDT
verification_method: Synthetic null/alternative statistical unit tests + verification on 750-scenario regression and classification tables

description: Silent fallback to coi_frequency remains reachable in extractor.py and window_slicer.py when bus_frequencies and pmu_sys_frequency are omitted
scientific_impact: Violates strict PMU-only contract if a caller passes a malformed dictionary lacking bus_frequencies but containing simulator coi_frequency
proposed_fix: Remove coi_frequency fallback in extractor.py and window_slicer.py; require observable PMU bus_frequencies and voltage_angles and raise ValueError/KeyError when PMU channels are missing
verification_method: Add dedicated negative tests removing bus_frequencies/voltage_angles while leaving coi_frequency present and asserting failure
